text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I will win... I'll definitely win...
I'll win and seize that very first one, without fail...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!
First place is Zenno Rob Roy!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The prestigious Autumn Shield!!
The one who claimed it is Zenno Rob Roy!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“Still, this isn't enough.
With this, finally—”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because it's... the very first one...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, did they just say 'the very first one'...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You said it, right?! You even talked about it in pre-race interviews...
Zenno Rob Roy, are you really aiming
for the Autumn Senior Triple Crown?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, but... In the first place,
she has to race every single month, you know?!
And against the absolute strongest contenders on the battlefield every time!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Just completing all of them should be grueling enough on its own...
And on top of that, winning every single one...!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know, she said she was gonna
'do it,' didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Hearing that really makes you
want to—cheer them on, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: ...Well, we've gotta watch this: the Japan Cup!
